类 ChunkResponse

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.batch.integration.chunk.ChunkResponse
所有已实现的接口:
Serializable
public class ChunkResponse extends Object implements Serializable
Encapsulates a response to processing a chunk of items, summarising the result as a StepContribution.
